title: Command from chat
description: Turn short messages into plans, code changes, file operations, and follow-ups without changing tools. Context compacts automatically when sessions grow long.

title: Bring your models
description: Route tasks to any of 30+ configured providers — OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, DeepSeek, xAI, local runtimes, and more. Override provider and model per run.

title: Tool-aware actions
description: Read, write, edit, patch, execute, fetch, and browse. 16 local tools with approval gates, rate limits, loop detection, and output sanitisation built in.

title: Persistent memory
description: Startup files — AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, IDENTITY.md, MEMORY.md, and more — keep project context and preferences available across sessions without polluting every prompt.

title: Observable work
description: Every tool call streams its state, inputs, result, and duration to the UI. Pre-run safety hooks block unsafe requests before the provider is called.

title: Human approval gates
description: Configure where the assistant can act freely, where it must pause, and how tool and MCP operations are reviewed before execution.

title: Composable skills
description: Package repeated tasks into named skills with required tools, permissions, visibility rules, and model guidance. Skill discovery runs at the start of each turn.

title: Channel-native updates
description: Send progress reports, approval requests, and summaries to 22 messaging platforms — Telegram, Slack, Discord, WhatsApp, iMessage, Matrix, and more.

title: Scheduled tasks
description: Cron, interval, and one-time schedules with timezone support, missed-run policies, concurrency controls, and per-schedule audit trails.

title: Background tasks
description: Run agent turns, image generation, video creation, OCR, and sound jobs concurrently with cooperative cancellation and lifecycle event tracking.

title: Voice in, voice out
description: Live dictation via speech-to-text and synthesized spoken responses via text-to-speech. Provider-agnostic — configure OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Deepgram, Cartesia, and more.

title: MCP and plugin tools
description: Extend the tool surface with Model Context Protocol servers, LSP capabilities, client-hosted tools, and plugin integrations without changing the core agent loop.
